scope.excluded: NU and NUS inventories are owned by parallel UI/Grid audits.

acceptance: Mount, initialize, activate, deactivate, reload and dispose independent main/Popup/Tab/Document instances.
Abort requests and remove owned listeners/subscriptions; no late DOM writes or cross-page cleanup.
Crosswalk caller/opener/request metadata and lifecycle order without mutable global controller discovery.

C02.current: mountPage URL view uses direct fetch; no communicator prepare/after connection
acceptance: Use one typed view transport policy in every page container.
Authentication/header preparation, response transformation, error/finalization and cancellation apply to remote HTML.
Validate inert roots, unique IDs and failed-load cleanup.

C03.current: URL views reject executable HTML; explicit ESM controller factory required
acceptance: Demonstrate explicit controller plus inert view migration from executable block HTML.
Record exact controller discovery/execution loss and receive one consolidated decision before excluding it.

C04.current: createCommunicator prepare/after/decode; no global ordered error/complete filter phases
acceptance: Ordered request/response middleware transforms values once.
Error interception and completion run with deterministic success/failure/abort behavior.
Cancellation cannot be dropped by a replacement Request; page and data requests use intended policy.

C05.current: RequestOptions url/method/json/body/signal/decode, native Request/Response; explicit server conversion
acceptance: Prove legacy POST, GET q=JSON, object/whole-array and rowStatus wire recipes against expected server payloads.
Exercise content type, text/HTML/empty decoding, configured cache and CORS policies.
Review inherited AjaxSettings, location-change guards and any unsupported transport before deciding omission.

C06.current: controller factories and explicit wrappers; no arbitrary pointcut/advisor runtime
acceptance: Demonstrate before/after/around/error wrapper alternatives, ordering, arguments and returned values.
Record custom pointcut and automatic method-path/view selection loss; obtain consolidated decision or supply equivalent support.

C07.current: explicit typed controller init and binder composition; no p./e. runtime interpreter
acceptance: Await common-code/data-code requests and apply filter/selected defaults before dependent init.
Typed component/declaration hooks and actions preserve useful ordering, nested ownership and cleanup.
Retire only interpreted string conventions if approved; c.* is application-owned communicator storage, not an interpreter.

C08.current: Grid/List onSelect has RowId; arbitrary DOM row-action identity is private
acceptance: Arbitrary row control events expose stable RowId/value/event through a typed owned hook.
After sort/filter/page/rebind, repeated row controls affect the right row and preserve binding-before-action ordering.
Dispose removes delegation; grouped radios/checkboxes and custom selector targets work.
Shared Form/Grid/List/Tree changes reach only subscribers of the same store.
Update one field/row and structural mutations without notification loops.
Detached/disposed consumers do not remain registered or affect another page.

C10.current: frozen JSON Rows with store-local RowId, separate changes/revert; app payload projection
acceptance: Insert/update/delete/revert and selected/checked/modified projections preserve intended raw data.
Nested immutable values and valid drafts remain stable through sort/filter; old mutable/non-JSON boundaries get explicit review.
Wire conversion omits RowId and retains server business keys, rowStatus and requested projected fields.
Every retained name and combined alias resolves from HTML and typed rules in Form, Grid and List.
Raw/display/unformat lifecycle, blank required semantics, arguments and localized errors are covered.
Custom global-rule use gets a local/shared configuration crosswalk; mask/date/time/byte transitive dependencies remain.

C12.current: display-only date format; explicit bindDatePicker; multiple date rule args rejected
acceptance: Date/month declarations or equivalent typed declarations attach an owned calendar and update raw Form values.
Show/hide/select veto and date/month range options retain intended behavior.
Formatted display and picker selection do not corrupt raw values or duplicate IDs.

C13.current: explicit handles, controller closures/input and per-binding RuleSet; no N.context or instance registry
acceptance: One app configuration supplies component defaults, locale/messages and services consistently across page instances.
Explicit handles replace component/controller lookup with clear lifetime.
Any lost runtime registry/locale-switch workflow is named in consolidated retirement review.

C14.current: normal source lint/checks and ESM sourcemaps proposed; no shipped runtime N.code
acceptance: Crosswalk selector-scope and component-value checks plus custom findings/exclusions/severity/abort behavior.
Explain loss of application-wired runtime HTML inspection and sourceURL injection.
Obtain consolidated decision or retain an equivalent scoped inspection workflow.

C15.current: native DOM/JS, private feature helpers, comparator/predicate view state; no public utility catalog
acceptance: Used helper outcomes remain in their owners after native/private rewrites.
Selection/data projection, sorting/filtering, input blocking, scrolling and animation lifetime retain behavior.

Inspect declaration/configuration/transitive paths before treating a convenience function as unrelated; handler enumeration/priority and string expression evaluation require explicit capability review.

retirement_groups.lost: Executing embedded scripts while loading remote block HTML and automatically discovering its controller.
retirement_groups.replacement: Inert authored HTML plus explicitly imported ESM controller factories and one common typed page loader.
retirement_groups.reason: Explicit modules and owned loading simplify cancellation, instance scope and analysis.
retirement_groups.closure: Affected legacy callers/options must be resolved before the one whole-framework proposal.

retirement_groups.lost: Automatic controller method interception selected by dotted path, view selector or custom pointcut, including around proceed and synchronous error advice.
retirement_groups.replacement: Explicit typed controller decorators/wrappers and lifecycle composition.
retirement_groups.reason: Avoid a general mutable interception engine while retaining concrete cross-cutting workflows.
retirement_groups.closure: Wrapper examples and affected advisor configurations still need acceptance.

retirement_groups.lost: Interpreting p.* and e.* controller property names, replacing declarations with handles, and invoking string action names automatically.
retirement_groups.replacement: Typed declarations, explicit binders/functions and awaited code-data initialization.
retirement_groups.reason: Reduce hidden naming conventions and dynamic controller mutation.
retirement_groups.closure: c.* stores communicator functions supplied by applications and is not independently parsed.

retirement_groups.lost: Global context/instance registry discovery, app-wide mutable defaults and global locale switches through N APIs.
retirement_groups.replacement: Explicit handles plus application-owned shared configuration/services and local typed rule overrides.
retirement_groups.reason: Clear instance ownership and predictable concurrent views.
retirement_groups.closure: Configuration update/localization propagation behavior remains open.

retirement_groups.lost: Application-wired runtime HTML inspection, custom findings, exclusions, severity/abort reporting and sourceURL injection.
retirement_groups.replacement: Build-time source checks, scoped-selector conventions and ESM sourcemaps.
retirement_groups.reason: Legacy checker understands jQuery/string pages; optional source analysis need not ship in runtime.
retirement_groups.closure: No automatic internal call is not proof this documented optional workflow is unused.

retirement_groups.lost: Public bound-handler enumeration, priority reordering through jQuery internals and executable string conditions for data filtering.
retirement_groups.replacement: Owned native event composition and typed predicate/comparator functions.
retirement_groups.reason: Remove fragile event internals and expression evaluation while retaining owning UI outcomes.
retirement_groups.closure: Custom event and expression callers plus :regexp selector convenience require individual mapping.

retirement_groups.lost: Potential unsupported synchronous XHR, script/JSONP decoding and other inherited jQuery AjaxSettings workflows.
retirement_groups.replacement: Async fetch with native Request/Response, explicit CORS, decoding and scoped cancellation; unsupported alternatives need decision.
retirement_groups.reason: AjaxSettingsBase inheritance is broader than the 14 constructor literals.
retirement_groups.closure: This is an investigation group, not a finalized omission set; enumerate inherited options and actual usages first.

retirement_groups.lost: Potential standalone data formatter/validator objects and manual format/unformat/validate events outside bound UI.
retirement_groups.replacement: Retained private rule engine in owning binders plus typed local rules; any standalone requirement needs explicit classification.
retirement_groups.reason: Avoid a generic utility package without dropping framework-reachable rule behavior.
retirement_groups.closure: Used Form wrappers cannot be called unused. Separate public convenience ownership from genuinely lost supported workflows.

retirement_groups.lost: Generic string/array/JSON/cookie/date/logging convenience entry points that have no remaining owning framework responsibility.
retirement_groups.replacement: Standard JS/browser APIs or application code; used behavior is rewritten locally.
retirement_groups.reason: No separate utility/legacy package is needed.
retirement_groups.closure: No candidate is marked unused solely from static reference absence; externally exposed aliases and documented use remain recorded.

approval_policy.one_consolidated_user_decision: Only after whole-framework P0 mapping and the complete lost-capability proposal; no omission approved here.
approval_policy.unused_helpers: Removal is authorized only after direct/transitive/configuration/declaration/rule ownership checks; replaceable used helpers retain owning behavior.
approval_policy.api_contracts: Proposed current equivalents are descriptions, not new public signatures. Stage contract review remains separate.
approval_policy.runtime_verification: No runtime tests, old performance gates or historical artifact claims are rerun or recertified by this mapping.

limits: Class/member/literal-option mapping completeness is not behavioral closure.
Root N aliases and jQuery.fn methods expose public paths; incoming static paths do not resolve all dynamic receiver calls.
Constructor literals omit merged defaults, inherited AjaxSettings, nested object callbacks and prototype/global extensions.
Standards replacements are planned/present scopes, not proof of every legacy edge case; known legacy defects need intended-behavior review.
Current refs describe the source read during this task; source may change in parallel; source fingerprints are included.

additional_dynamic_paths.title: Root assembly/aliases
additional_dynamic_paths.observed_path: Object.assign exposes statics; prototype methods become jQuery.fn except request; comm/notify factories replace class values. NT/NCD attach later. Instance lookups and shorthand receiver calls remain dynamic.
additional_dynamic_paths.remaining_acceptance: Resolve every public N/jQuery alias, factory-lost static path and downstream dynamic call without duplicating unsupported APIs.

additional_dynamic_paths.title: External configuration/default merges
additional_dynamic_paths.observed_path: Core locale/Y-N checkbox/charByteLength/gcMode; architecture page/context/request/filter/AOP; global userRules/messages; date separators; core.excludeMapFromKeys is read by projection.
additional_dynamic_paths.remaining_acceptance: Crosswalk shared defaults/localization, checkbox raw states and merged options; constructor inventory does not enumerate them.

additional_dynamic_paths.title: Formatter dynamic and configured rule paths
additional_dynamic_paths.observed_path: HTML/field tuple names dispatch dynamically; config userRules extends the class; Form invokes wrappers; generic/numeric rules reach NC.mask; date reaches date formatting and optional calendar attachment.
additional_dynamic_paths.remaining_acceptance: All 23 rule names and arguments, field-to-tuple maps, local/global overrides, configured separators, raw lifecycle and auto picker require acceptance.

additional_dynamic_paths.title: Validator dynamic/config/message paths
additional_dynamic_paths.observed_path: Names lowercased and combinations sorted; config userRules/messages plus locale are read; Form and row Forms create validate handlers; byte rules reach configurable counting.
additional_dynamic_paths.remaining_acceptance: All 41 names, blank-required semantics, typed per-field rules, message fallback, equalTo selector-to-field migration and known defect corrections require closure.

additional_dynamic_paths.title: Inherited Ajax transport/options
additional_dynamic_paths.observed_path: Request extends JQuery.AjaxSettingsBase and merged opts reach NA.ajax; timeout/headers/xhrFields/credentials/transport/processData and other inherited settings exceed 14 literals.
additional_dynamic_paths.remaining_acceptance: Enumerate inherited settings and relevant examples; demonstrate native HTTP recipes and list actual unsupported workflows for one batch review.

additional_dynamic_paths.title: Object-defined filter/advisor hooks
additional_dynamic_paths.observed_path: AOP object contains custom pointcuts and recursive wrap; filter phase arrays copy static functions onto receivers; config can register phase functions; callbacks are not distinct class members.
additional_dynamic_paths.remaining_acceptance: Map pointcuts/proceed/advice types and ordered beforeInit/afterInit/beforeSend/success/error/complete; preserve cancellation/transformation/error/finalization.

additional_dynamic_paths.title: DataSync identity/lifetime
additional_dynamic_paths.observed_path: Shared DOM singleton observes components with identical data arrays; notify routes row/key updates; gc.ds tries to refresh registry.
additional_dynamic_paths.remaining_acceptance: Test shared stores, row/field structural updates and disposal; fix legacy stale-registration defects rather than preserving them.

additional_dynamic_paths.title: Data predicates/comparators/projection
additional_dynamic_paths.observed_path: List/Grid use datafilter for changed/deleted/selected projections and datasort for header sorts; mapFromKeys is used by many UI data accessors and merges extra keys.
additional_dynamic_paths.remaining_acceptance: Preserve typed predicate/field sort and accessor projections; isolate string-expression capability and its defective AND rewriting before batch decision.

additional_dynamic_paths.title: TEMPLATE application activation
additional_dynamic_paths.observed_path: Optional module is inert until an app ^init$ around advisor calls it; codeUrl/codeKey requests precede hooks/components/events/actions/init/onOpenDefer. c.* holds app functions and is not parsed.
additional_dynamic_paths.remaining_acceptance: Typed declarations retain useful ordering/common code/filter/default/search behavior; arbitrary row events need stable identity; interpreted strings are only a proposed retirement.

additional_dynamic_paths.title: Optional runtime inspection
additional_dynamic_paths.observed_path: App filters/direct calls invoke custom inspection rules/report/sourceURL; severityLevels is absent from legacy types; first-script regex/exclusions and abortOnError remain public workflows.
additional_dynamic_paths.remaining_acceptance: Classify custom rule/report/filter callers; proposed build-time checks are not automatically equivalent and require batch review.

additional_dynamic_paths.title: UI-owned event helpers and regexp selector
additional_dynamic_paths.observed_path: tpBind/events/vals are UI-reachable; event duration/cancel/scroll helpers serve Button/Tabs/DatePicker/Popup/Grid/Notify. :regexp adds attribute/data/class/CSS matching outside class inventory.
additional_dynamic_paths.remaining_acceptance: Resolve interaction ownership; maintain bind-before-action order and zero-duration/scroll lifetime. Selector utility boundary is not decided by absent calls.

additional_dynamic_paths.title: Date global/prototype extensions
additional_dynamic_paths.observed_path: Date.prototype.formatDate, optional time argument and DATE_ATOM/ISO8601/RFC2822/W3C strings are not class members; NC.date.format and calendars call the extension.
additional_dynamic_paths.remaining_acceptance: Private datePattern includes the token family; compare escaping/timezone/leap/optional-time and configured format behavior. Prototype/helper exports get a separate convenience boundary.

additional_dynamic_paths.title: Mask constructor-assigned state/function
additional_dynamic_paths.observed_path: Mask constructor assigns format/error/errorCodes/strippedValue/allowPartial and throwError beyond the class-member checklist.
additional_dynamic_paths.remaining_acceptance: Retain intended generic/numeric rule outcomes; separately classify standalone mutable mask diagnostics and partial-input callers.

additional_dynamic_paths.title: Remote HTML insertion modes
additional_dynamic_paths.observed_path: append and externally merged replace alter host contents and locate the resulting controller; scripts run via jQuery HTML insertion.
additional_dynamic_paths.remaining_acceptance: Typed loader handles destination, additive/replacement ownership and init ordering; executable discovery is pending R01.

additional_dynamic_paths.title: Representative existing-server payload
additional_dynamic_paths.observed_path: Changed-row accessor plus dataIsArray sends rows with rowStatus; Form edits shared Grid objects.
additional_dynamic_paths.remaining_acceptance: Migration recipe proves POST array and change projection without exposing internal RowId; no runtime gate is recertified here.

current_rule_catalogs.extraction: Literal two-space source entry keys; legacy class/member counts use AST.

verification.tests_and_historical_evidence: No runtime/unit/browser tests, old performance results or prior artifacts were rerun or recertified.
verification.mapping_validation: Exact class/member/option set matching, valid family/dynamic IDs, nonempty current/owner/acceptance fields and current legacy fingerprints checked.

read_proxy.definition: Unique referenced files read by hashing/source tools during this task. Searches/selected excerpts differ from full model context. Repeated reads and dependency internals excluded. Not actual tokens.

retirement_proposal_status: Candidate-group draft only. Whole-framework UI/Grid mappings, inherited/config/declaration acceptance and affected caller closure must finish before the single approval request.

inheritance.entry_defaults_scope: Defaults apply recursively by containing collection: files=file, classes=class, members=member, literal_options=literal_option, additional_dynamic_paths=additional_dynamic_path, unresolved=unresolved. Explicit fields override defaults; absent nested objects inherit their complete default object.
inheritance.parent_file_path: Omitted legacy_anchor.path on classes/members/literal_options equals the enclosing file.path. Other concrete paths remain explicit.
inheritance.profile_ids: Omitted class planned_acceptance_profile_ids or member/option planned_acceptance.profile_ids equals that entry.feature_ids; those IDs reference profiles and do not imply acceptance was executed.
inheritance.arrays: A default empty array means no additional fact was recorded in that field. It is not unused evidence or completed closure. Nondefault arrays and all concrete cases/references remain.
inheritance.format: Surface and source records occupy one JSON line each to reduce repeated indentation. JSON semantics are unchanged; parser-based review should expand defaults before comparing the previous schema.

class.current_scope: See individual members; namespace is not behavioral closure.

retirement.reason: Used replaceable machinery preserves owning outcomes.

reachability.source: literal constructor assignment plus downstream option branches

normalization.purpose: Lossless default/profile/path inheritance and indentation compaction only; no source audit or behavior recertification.
normalization.semantic_round_trip: Expanded normalized document matched every original JSON value recursively, ignoring object-key order.
